review_candidates.title: Sr Staff Systems Architect Engineer (Solutions PO) (26-304)
review_candidates.description: RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time Description At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. Northrop Grumman Space Systems—Missile Defense Integration offers an excellent opportunity for a Sr Staff Systems Architect Engineer (Solutions PO) (26-304) to join our team of skilled and diverse professionals. Based in Colorado Springs, CO, or Huntsville, AL, this role is essential to supporting the U.S. President, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at the strategic, regional, and operational levels. This position does not provide relocation assistance and requires on-site work with no remote options. Position Overview The C2BMC program is a key component of the Missile Defense System (MDS). It enables the U.S. President, the Secretary of Defense, and Combatant Commanders at strategic, regional, and tactical levels to plan missile defense operations, monitor the battle, and dynamically employ networked sensors and weapon systems to achieve global and regional mission objectives. C2BMC delivers layered missile defense capabilities and serves as a force multiplier by connecting, integrating, and synchronizing autonomous sensor and weapon systems worldwide. This role sits at the heart of an integrated solutions architecture and systems engineering effort, working on a multi-company team to define the operational, physical, functional, and technical architectures that shape an evolving C2BMC capability. As the Product Owner for the architecture, you will own the backlog of architecture artifacts, prioritize capability delivery, and ensure that each increment aligns with stakeholder expectations and mission priorities. You will architect missile defense command-and-control and battle management systems, leveraging existing COTS/GOTS components while ensuring full DoD interoperability. A core responsibility is turning high-level mission needs into cohesive hardware/software solutions: analyzing requirements, articulating desired capabilities to developers, engineers, subject matter experts (SMEs), and users, and producing and maintaining system models, interface control documents, and functional flow diagrams. You will design and develop new systems, modernize legacy platforms, drive the roadmap for architectural evolution, lead portions of the design effort, and support internal and external design reviews with clear written and oral technical presentations. Essential Functions Serve as the architecture Product Owner for C2BMC solutions, owning the architecture backlog, prioritizing features and capabilities, and ensuring alignment with stakeholder and mission needs Work with a multi-company, cross-functional team to define operational, physical, functional, and technical architectures for evolving C2BMC capabilities Architect missile defense command and control and battle management systems that leverage COTS/GOTS components while ensuring compliance with DoD interoperability standards and constraints Translate high-level mission and operational needs into integrated hardware/software solutions, including clear requirements, capability descriptions, and architectural views Develop, maintain, and communicate key architecture artifacts such as system models, interface control documents (ICDs), data models, and functional flow diagrams Design and support modernization of legacy platforms, driving the roadmap for architectural evolution and technology insertion while considering TRL, risk, and lifecycle impacts Lead portions of the design effort and support or chair internal and external design reviews, providing clear, concise technical content and recommendations Collaborate closely with developers, engineers, SMEs, and system users to ensure architectures are implementable, testable, and aligned with program schedules and constraints Define and refine acceptance criteria for architectural releases, ensuring that delivered increments meet stakeholder expectations and are technically sound Contribute to the development and refinement of system test concepts and data analysis approaches that validate architectural performance and mission effectiveness Mentor junior engineers in systems architecture methods, modeling practices, and product ownership techniques, fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaboration Basic Qualifications Please list your current security clearance and IAT or relevant certifications on your resume, if applicable. A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field from an accredited university, along with 14 years of experience; or a Master’s degree (preferred) in a related field with 12 years of relevant work experience; or a PhD in a related discipline along with 10 years of experience Applicants must have a current, active in-scope Government-issued Secret security clearance at the time of application, which is required to start Demonstrated experience in systems engineering, solutions architecture, or closely related roles on complex defense or command-and-control programs Proven ability to work effectively in a multi-company, cross-functional team environment with competing priorities and evolving mission needs Strong written and oral communication skills; able to prepare and deliver clear, persuasive technical presentations and documentation Deep understanding of DoD and missile defense C2BMC architectures, system concepts, and standard test and data analysis techniques Ability to identify, define, and communicate desired capabilities to both technical and non-technical audiences Proficiency in creating architecture artifacts such as functional diagrams, interface definitions, and data models Structured, logical analytical approach to refining high-level needs into integrated hardware/software solutions Excellent written and oral communication skills; skilled at delivering concise, persuasive technical presentations to senior leadership and external stakeholders Demonstrated capability to lead complex architecture activities, mentor junior team members, and drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, test, and operations Preferred Qualifications Extensive track record designing, developing, and integrating complex command and control (C2) or battle management solutions Strong foundation in systems architecture, leveraging frameworks such as DoDAF, MODAF, or TOGAF to translate mission requirements into complete, technology-ready system solutions while respecting TRL and program constraints Regular experience participating in internal and external design reviews, producing architecture models and guidelines that steer both current initiatives and future development Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder priorities and define acceptance criteria for each architectural release Certified Product Owner (e.g., SAFe® POPM, CSPO, or equivalent) Certified Architect (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman) or equivalent demonstrated expertise Experience integrating COTS/GOTS components and applying DoD interoperability standards such as MAUD and STANAG Familiarity with model-based systems engineering (MBSE) tools (e.g., SysML, Enterprise Architect, MagicDraw/Cameo) Prior work on missile defense or other high-threat, high-availability command and control programs What We Can Offer You Northrop Grumman provides a comprehensive benefits package and a supportive work environment that encourages your growth, benefiting both employees and the company. The benefits are flexible and customizable, enabling you to choose options that suit your individual and family needs. Your benefits will include the following: Health Plan Savings Plan Paid Time Off Education Assistance Training and Development Flexible Work Arrangements https://benefits.northropgrumman.com/us/en2/BenefitsOverview/Pages/default.aspx #NGSpace #COSpace #NGFeaturedJobs #C2BMC #Architect #SystemEngineering #SpaceEngJobs Primary Level Salary Range: $175,300.00 - $262,900.00 The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business. The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. You will operate from your home office ideally located in Warsaw, Katowice or Krakow area with general administrative support from our European headquarters in Luxembourg. This position offers great challenges and has a direct impact on the final business result and growth opportunities. It is a unique opportunity to join a very dynamic organization, combining your technology focus and inter-human skills to support our global customer base. Responsibilities Traveling regularly to our customers (area covering Poland 60% of time and Central Europe (40%). Central Europe extends to Greece, you will be responsible for troubleshooting issues, installing or upgrading all Husky products. You will help our customers optimize their operations with on-site training and follow-up visits. You should be a self-started that understands the importance of customer satisfaction and can be an ambassador for our strong core values. Troubleshooting attitude and focus on correct working practices. Knowledge in PLC controls and in industrial automated systems. Your initiative, your team spirit and time management abilities enable you to deal with multiple priorities in a timely and proactive manner. Some experience in field service and injection molding would be considered an asset. Good English language skills. Fluent in Polish Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

The Senior Mechanical Engineer will work closely with engineering, project management, procurement, manufacturing, construction, operations, maintenance, suppliers, contractors, and clients to deliver reliable and efficient mechanical solutions. The role may also provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and junior team members. Key Responsibilities Lead and support the design, development, installation, testing, commissioning, and improvement of mechanical systems, equipment, machinery, components, and assemblies. Develop and review engineering calculations, technical specifications, drawings, layouts, equipment schedules, design documents, and technical reports. Analyse mechanical systems and components to ensure structural integrity, reliability, performance, efficiency, maintainability, and suitability for intended applications. Select appropriate materials, components, equipment, manufacturing methods, and engineering solutions based on technical, operational, environmental, and commercial requirements. Perform or review engineering calculations relating to loads, stresses, thermal performance, fluid flow, pressure, power requirements, tolerances, and equipment capacity where applicable. Use relevant engineering software and tools such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Inventor, Revit, ANSYS, MATLAB, or other discipline-specific platforms. Review technical designs and provide recommendations to improve functionality, reliability, manufacturability, safety, and cost efficiency. Coordinate mechanical engineering activities with electrical, civil, structural, process, instrumentation, architectural, and other multidisciplinary teams. Work with project managers to define technical requirements, project deliverables, schedules, resources, risks, and engineering milestones. Prepare technical specifications and support procurement teams in evaluating mechanical equipment, components, suppliers, and contractors. Review supplier drawings, technical submissions, quotations, datasheets, calculations, method statements, and equipment documentation. Participate in factory inspections, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), site inspections, installation reviews, commissioning activities, and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) where required. Provide technical support during manufacturing, installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance activities. Investigate equipment failures, mechanical problems, performance issues, and recurring defects and conduct root cause analysis to identify corrective actions. Develop or review preventive maintenance, reliability improvement, equipment optimisation, and engineering modification proposals. Monitor project progress and ensure mechanical deliverables are completed according to approved specifications, quality requirements, schedules, and budgets. Review engineering changes, technical deviations, non-conformances, and design modifications and assess their impact on safety, performance, cost, and schedule. Ensure mechanical designs and engineering activities comply with relevant industry standards, codes, regulations, company procedures, and health and safety requirements. Conduct technical risk assessments and identify potential engineering, operational, installation, maintenance, and safety risks. Coordinate with contractors and site teams to resolve technical issues and ensure mechanical works are executed according to approved designs and specifications. Monitor installation quality and verify that equipment, systems, materials, and workmanship meet engineering requirements. Prepare technical reports, progress updates, inspection records, commissioning documentation, engineering calculations, and project close-out documentation. Support budgeting, cost estimation, value engineering, equipment selection, and cost optimisation initiatives. Maintain accurate engineering records, drawings, specifications, calculations, equipment documentation, and revision histories. Communicate technical requirements and engineering recommendations clearly to clients, management, suppliers, contractors, and internal teams. Stay updated on mechanical engineering technologies, equipment developments, materials, industry standards, energy efficiency, automation, and engineering best practices. Identify opportunities to improve mechanical system performance, reliability, energy efficiency, maintainability, safety, and operational efficiency. Provide technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior engineers and engineering team members. Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the development of engineering standards, procedures, templates, and best practices. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. Proven experience in mechanical engineering, equipment design, project engineering, manufacturing, construction, facilities, industrial systems, or a related field. Strong knowledge of mechanical engineering principles, equipment, systems, materials, manufacturing processes, and engineering practices. Experience with engineering drawings, technical specifications, calculations, equipment selection, and design documentation. Proficiency in relevant CAD, engineering analysis, modelling, or simulation software. Strong understanding of engineering standards, codes, quality requirements, and health and safety practices. Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering teams, contractors, suppliers, manufacturers, and project stakeholders. Strong technical problem-solving and root cause analysis skills. Ability to evaluate technical proposals, supplier documentation, equipment specifications, and engineering solutions. Good understanding of project management principles, cost control, scheduling, risk management, and change control. Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple engineering activities and priorities. Strong analytical and decision-making abilities with a practical and solutions-oriented approach. Ability to work independently while providing technical leadership and guidance to junior engineering staff. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Professional engineering registration, chartered status, or relevant technical certification will be an advantage. Experience with industrial equipment, HVAC, MEP systems, manufacturing, energy, oil and gas, construction, automotive, or other specialised mechanical environments will be an advantage.
